No separate different registered90143 type or multi-art variant exists in V12.5.
90143.userDecision: All90143 presentations, including90143+90142, are non-doors. Approved joined construction must receive a single working identity; its old loose elements must be hidden and migrated. Do not invent separate IDs for yaw/copies of the same grille.
90143.practicalPlan: Keep existing primary90143 if replacing the loose lower type with the joined non-door grille and removing90142 from workingCreative. If any genuinely independent lower grille must remain, keep90143 for it and allocate a never-used append-only number>=93230 for the joined whole. Preserve exact old source yaw/mount/SourceShift and component UUID/settings during migration; never allocate a number per gallery copy.
